visualCharacteristics: Dense 5-column image-only grid of social posts (author, handle and date revealed on hover; click opens a post overlay); 10 initial items with a centered green Load more button that appends more.
contentPattern: Grid of social (Instagram) post tiles: image, author, handle, date, caption excerpt; each opens a post overlay; 'Load more' button. Source is a Sprinklr embed (sprinklr-embed-24392)
usage: Dense image grid of social media posts with hover details, a post overlay on click and a Load more button.
reuseGuidance: One row per post: image | author, handle, date, caption, optional link to the post. Ten posts show at first; Load more reveals ten more. Use cards for regular content cards.
structure: One row per post: image | author, handle, date, caption, link
